Container.Name: palworld-game-server
Container.Overview: Modded Palworld 1.0 dedicated server. Runs the WINDOWS server binary under plain WineHQ stable (NOT Proton) so it can load UE4SS server-side mods and PalDefender. The game binary itself is downloaded by SteamCMD to the appdata volume on first boot (~12-15GB) — nothing of Pocketpair's ships in the image. Pairs with the Palworld dashboard. Requires seccomp=unconfined + SYS_PTRACE (Wine ptrace) — preset in Extra Parameters. A headless Xvfb display is baked in (recent Palworld builds need a display context during graphics init even headless). RAM: 16GB minimum, 32GB for community servers.
Container.Requires: 16GB+ RAM. First boot downloads ~12-15GB via SteamCMD to the game path.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Players connect here. Forward this at your router.

Config.Name: Steam Query Port
Config.Description: Community server browser. Optional.

Config.Name: RCON Port
Config.Description: Admin console. Needed by the dashboard. Keep INTERNAL — do NOT port-forward at your router.

Config.Name: REST API Port
Config.Description: Game REST API the dashboard polls. Keep INTERNAL — do NOT port-forward.

Config.Name: PalDefender REST Port
Config.Description: PalDefender REST (only if ENABLE_PALDEFENDER=true). Keep INTERNAL — do NOT port-forward.

Config.Name: Game data
Config.Description: Server install, saves, mods, backups. The ~12-15GB game lands here on first boot.

Config.Name: Mod staging
Config.Description: Optional host-side mod staging: Win64/ (UE4SS) and pak/ (.pak). Copied in on start.

Config.Name: Host machine-id
Config.Description: Stable machine-id for Steam. Remove this mapping if your host has no /etc/machine-id.

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Admin password for RCON + REST. Use 32 alphanumeric chars (punctuation breaks the INI/argv/compose path). CHANGE THIS.

Config.Name: SERVER_NAME
Config.Description: Server name shown in the browser.

Config.Name: SERVER_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Join password (blank = open server).

Config.Name: MAX_PLAYERS
Config.Description: Max concurrent players (hard cap 32).

Config.Name: WINEDLLOVERRIDES
Config.Description: REQUIRED for mod injection (dwmapi=UE4SS, d3d9=PalDefender). Do NOT change or clear.

Config.Name: ENABLE_UE4SS
Config.Description: Auto-install the UE4SS mod framework on boot.

Config.Name: ENABLE_PALDEFENDER
Config.Description: Install PalDefender anti-cheat (needs PALDEFENDER_URL).

Config.Name: PALDEFENDER_URL
Config.Description: Download URL for the PalDefender release (only if ENABLE_PALDEFENDER=true).

Config.Name: RCON_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable RCON (needed by the dashboard).

Config.Name: REST_API_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable the game REST API (needed by the dashboard).

Config.Name: COMMUNITY
Config.Description: Advertise in the community server browser.

Config.Name: CROSSPLAY_PLATFORMS
Config.Description: Platforms allowed to connect.

Config.Name: PUBLIC_IP
Config.Description: Advertised public IP (usually leave blank; auto-detected).

Config.Name: ENABLE_PVP
Config.Description: Sets all three required PvP toggles together.

Config.Name: DIFFICULTY
Config.Description: None (custom rates), Casual, Normal, or Hard.

Config.Name: DEATH_PENALTY
Config.Description: None, Item, ItemAndEquipment, or All.

Config.Name: EXP_RATE
Config.Description: XP multiplier (1.0 = vanilla). Blank = ini default.

Config.Name: PAL_CAPTURE_RATE
Config.Description: Capture multiplier. Blank = ini default.

Config.Name: WORK_SPEED_RATE
Config.Description: Pal work-speed multiplier. Blank = ini default.

Config.Name: TARGET_MANIFEST_ID
Config.Description: Lock to a specific Steam build (prevents an update outpacing UE4SS). Blank = latest.

Config.Name: ALWAYS_UPDATE_ON_START
Config.Description: Run SteamCMD validation on every start (slower boot).

Config.Name: BACKUP_ENABLED
Config.Description: Scheduled in-container backups via supercronic to the game path's backups/.

Config.Name: BACKUP_CRON_EXPRESSION
Config.Description: Cron schedule for backups (default midnight daily).

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Container timezone (e.g. America/Los_Angeles).
